create_file_hash: create a SHA-256 hash of a file given a Path or BytesIO stream
create_hash: create a SHA-256 hash of a UTF-8 encoded string
download_url_with_progress: download a URL with an optional progress bar and return its contents as a BytesIO buffer
chunkify_list: chunk a list into sublists of a specified size using an iterator
chunkify_iterator: chunk an arbitrary iterable into sublists of a specified size
